$comment: Intended mapping for the ambientui design file. No file is connected yet — the key arrives from the Foundation page (saved config figmaFileUrl); collections below are the spec the first sync builds, then this file records the verified reality. Procedure: figma/figma-sync.md.

Foundation.role: the saved Foundation config — accent pair, ring, gray-tinted surfaces, ambient accent bridge

Radius.role: all five presets (None/Small/Medium/Large/Full) + Radius/Active aliasing the saved step and its derived sm…4xl

Ambient Scale.role: Space/1…10 (8px grid from 2px, raw px) · Text/1…9 (resolved at the saved base size) · Base/Font size

excluded.unsaved live edits: sync reads the saved config only — Save Theme is the commit point
excluded.font weights: Figma style-name strings, not numeric weights
excluded.components: never written by the sync; hand-authored ambientui components bind to Foundation variables and are additive only
